datasets.source: Eurostat Data Browser: nama_10r_2gdp and nama_10r_3gdp
datasets.transformation: GDP observations for 2014-2021 and NUTS labels adapted into a parent-child GraphML forest.
datasets.reuse_basis: Eurostat copyright notice and European Commission reuse policy; reuse authorized with source acknowledgement and modification notice.

datasets.source: ACM Computing Classification System taxonomy and public ACM Digital Library publication records
datasets.source_period: Monthly publication counts over the 48-month 2019-2022 study window (47 or 48 finite observations per analyzed vertex)
datasets.accessed: Original access date not retained; provenance recorded 2026-08-17
datasets.transformation: ACM CCS labels and hierarchy were combined with monthly publication counts per field and serialized as GraphML.
datasets.reuse_basis: Project-author academic research release authorization with ACM CCS attribution; reuse remains subject to applicable ACM source terms and is separate from the software MIT license.
datasets.authorization_record: Project author confirmed repository upload authorization on 2026-08-17.
datasets.downstream_reuse: Academic research reuse permitted with attribution under project-author authorization, subject to applicable ACM source terms.

datasets.source: AKShare open-source Python financial-data interface using public-source Chinese market data
datasets.source_period: Daily Chinese equity series, 2023 (242 observations per vertex)
datasets.accessed: Original access date and AKShare version not retained; provenance recorded 2026-08-17
datasets.transformation: Daily Chinese equity series acquired through AKShare were organized by exchange and industry into a depth-5 hierarchy and serialized as GraphML.
datasets.reuse_basis: AKShare client code is MIT licensed; AKShare documents public data sources and restricts its interface and related data to non-commercial academic research. Project-author public research release authorization was confirmed 2026-08-17.
datasets.authorization_record: Project author confirmed repository upload authorization on 2026-08-17.
datasets.downstream_reuse: Non-commercial academic research reuse permitted with attribution under project-author authorization, subject to AKShare and underlying-source conditions.
